import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, '/private/tmp/nanogpt-macbook-build/scripts')
from compare_sampling import compare, reference_modules
from nanogpt_macbook import engine
from nanogpt_macbook.benchmark import source_info
from nanogpt_macbook.config import PRESETS

args = argparse.Namespace(pairs=10, tokens=1, temperature=0.8, top_k=40, seed=42, out=Path('/private/tmp/ngpt-window-124b2c0-short.json'))
assert not args.out.exists()
engine.select_device('gpu', 2)
reference, info = reference_modules('7f741e3')
record = dict(source=source_info(), reference=info, method=dict(device='gpu', pairs=10, temperature=0.8, top_k=40, seed=42, generated_bytes='per result', warmup='weights evaluated; complete generation including compilation timed; shared process kernel caches'), results=[])
for preset, (config, _) in PRESETS.items():
    for length in [16, config.context-1, config.context]:
        prompt = ('After the rain, Mira opened the window. '*20)[:length]
        for count in [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32]:
            args.tokens = count
            compare(config, preset, prompt, args, reference, record)
            record['results'][-1]['generated_bytes'] = count
            args.out.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
